items.title: Zutty Singleton and Marge Singleton Interview, 1969-02-08

ctx.x: We would rush out to get us stripes and we're in something to keep in the mood. But I know he gambled with my brother. And you knew it was jelly because of your brother. Sure, everybody knew it in the middle. He's Hawkins. Hawkins brother. Well, their sister's children and I went to the movies together. They were in their house a lot playing the piano. They had a piano also. Was his name up at all in the movie?

In other words, if Hawkins didn't know him, you wouldn't have known it was Jelly Roll. It was just the guy who was playing piano at the Nickelodeon. Yeah, but they gave you their job because they owned the Nickelodeon. They used to go to their sister's house. Their niece and their nephews and all, they all was like a kind of a family. They weren't a couple of pretty family brothers. Look at these Hawkins brothers. They were very fair.

items.title: Zutty Singleton and Marge Singleton Interview, 1969-02-08
items.q: The Hawkins brothers gambled a lot. And I learned a whole lot.

ctx.x: And he didn't want to eat money.

And he wasn't dressed up. He wasn't shocked then. I remember his relationship. But he gambled a lot. My brother gambled a lot. The Hawkins brothers gambled a lot. And I learned a whole lot. They had a nephew named Frank. Frank, yeah. He read. And they had a lot of piano in their saloon. They never doubt this. So all came to the other direction of us. Frank, he read. He read. He read.
